thread:
sam: Heads-up — telemetry fanout dropped ~30% of GPU usage events for eu-west last night around 02:15 UTC. Forecast feed shows a gap for 02:00-03:10 which will skew weekly capacity projections. Anyone else seeing this?
ops-bot: alert created: #INC-4125 — kafka-proxy-fanout-failure (severity: medium) :rotating_light:
marIa: I saw retries + 504s from the fanout proxies. Load balancer config rollback happened at 02:10 for a small TLS cert fix; suspect the proxy pool didn't warm up.
derek: Confirmed — consumer offsets in the replay topic jumped and then paused. Offsets stuck ~+150k between 02:06-02:25. I can start a targeted replayer for that window unless we prefer a broader backfill.
leila: For forecasting, a targeted reingest 02:00-03:15 should be enough. Also suggest we apply a temporal smoothing to the forecasting input for holiday season (dampen single-hour dips >20%). Otherwise autoscaler will overreact.
jin: Quick Q: which metric names are impacted so we can update dashboards/alerts? Is it gpu.hours.v1.count or the new per-model metric?
maria: Both — the fanout sits before enrichment so raw events for gpu.hours.v1.count and gpu.hours.per_model are both affected. Dashboards using hourly rollups will show the hole.
sam: Derek, can you run the replayer with conservative throttle? Also check for duplicate detection. We should avoid double-counting when consumers resume.
derek: Will do. Plan: run replayer for partitions 12-18 with throttle 100eps, dedupe using event_id. Command:
```
./replayer --topic=telemetry-usage-raw --from=1934560000 --to=1934563600 --partitions=12-18 --rate=100 --dedupe=true
```
expect ~45m to complete.
leila: After reingest, we should run a quick validation job to compare pre/post distributions and auto-flag if >2% delta in hourly totals. I can add a temporary job in the forecast pipeline.
jin: I'll patch the EU dashboards to show a red stripe for the affected hour and add a note in the widget explaining reingest so oncall understands the spike.
maria: Also, let's tweak the fanout LB healthcheck to a stricter probe. Current 10s interval is too slow for quick rollbacks. Suggest 5s + consecutive failures 2.
sam: Agreed. Who owns the LB change? @maria?
maria: I can do it after replayer completes.
ops-bot: scheduled job: replayer job created by derek — job id replay-1934568 (ETA 45m)
derek: Replayer started. Monitoring consumer lag + output topic TPS. Will ping here on completion.
leila: For forecasting algorithm, I'll add a holiday smoothing toggle that uses a rolling median of 3 hours and a conservative lower bound at 80% of expected. That should reduce churn during brief telemetry outages.
sam: Also note: there's a Dedicated maintenance window tomorrow 03:00-04:00 UTC for eu-west; avoid large backfills overlapping that. Marking as blocker if replayer hits that window.
jin: Small ops note: update the alert threshold on telemetry-latency to 15% instead of 10% during major holidays to reduce noise. We'll revert afterwards.
derek: Replayer finished. Output checks: event_count delta +0.4% vs expected, dedupe rate ~0.7%. Pushing validated data to forecast-prod.
leila: Validation job ran: hourly totals now within 0.9% of baseline. Smoothing flag engaged for next 24h.
sam: Great, thanks team. Follow-ups: maria to patch LB healthcheck, jin to annotate dashboards, leila to ship smoothing toggle to prod, derek to add replayer runbook notes. I'll close INC-4125 once all done. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: incident INC-4125 status updated -> resolved (root cause: LB rollback + proxy warm-up failure).
